summary: Prior findings are addressed, but the OnCurve provenance paragraph is now stale in two places after the log-norm lemma moved to SegmentSum.lean, two module docstrings omit newly added public declarations (including the PR's exported hypothesis predicate), and one docstring gives a restriction recipe that cannot typecheck.
